verdict.rationale: Sentry ships a built-in AI agent, Seer, that takes delegated work inside the product. It automatically root-causes and triages issues, generates code fixes and opens PRs via Autofix, reviews code changes, and answers natural-language questions about telemetry. Its agent can also be assigned Linear issues. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's delegation quality, and in-depth documentation of how users hand off and supervise arbitrary tasks (the evidence is short first-party snippets).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: PR Creation: Use Autofix to generate a code fix and create a PR.
